productArea.name: Projects
productArea.scope: Search, filter, create, edit, close, and delete personal, organization, and repository projects, then manage their boards, columns, colors, and issue membership. Editing an issue opened from a board and managing its labels or milestones are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Projects in the seeded repository, then create or open a project and manage its board and issue membership.
Choose Projects on your user profile to manage personal projects.
Open an organization you can access and choose Projects. Create a disposable organization if none exists.
